steps.description: Start the sequence at hit: res = 1 word so far. Each BFS level is one more word.
Poll hit (sequence length 1). Try every letter at every position.
Changing letter 1 of hit to 'o' gives hot, a listed word not seen yet. Queue it.
Level done. The next level's words are 2 words into the sequence: res = 2.
Poll hot (sequence length 2). Try every letter at every position.
Changing letter 0 of hot to 'd' gives dot, a listed word not seen yet. Queue it.
Changing letter 0 of hot to 'l' gives lot, a listed word not seen yet. Queue it.
Level done. The next level's words are 3 words into the sequence: res = 3.
Poll dot (sequence length 3). Try every letter at every position.
Changing letter 2 of dot to 'g' gives dog, a listed word not seen yet. Queue it.
Poll lot (sequence length 3). Try every letter at every position.
Changing letter 2 of lot to 'g' gives log, a listed word not seen yet. Queue it.
Level done. The next level's words are 4 words into the sequence: res = 4.
Poll dog (sequence length 4). Try every letter at every position.
Changing letter 0 of dog to 'c' gives cog, a listed word not seen yet. Queue it.
Poll log (sequence length 4). Try every letter at every position.
Level done. The next level's words are 5 words into the sequence: res = 5.
Polled cog, which is endWord: the shortest sequence has res = 5 words.
